changes_made.explanation: Removed 'English' from languages since generated outputs are Python code, not natural language. Added Qwen2-VL-2B which was mentioned in experiments. Removed generic 'Qwen2-VL' and kept specific model versions. Consolidated output descriptions.

Consolidated all similarity metrics under 'code similarity' since they are components of the ChartMimic benchmark's low-level metrics. Normalized GPT-4o evaluation methods to 'GPT-4o score'. Added 'code execution success' which is explicitly mentioned as a metric.
Consolidated method descriptions to 'image comparison scoring'. No specific evaluation criteria were mentioned for the LLM judge, so criteria remains empty.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper only uses automatic metrics and GPT-4o as judge.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on chart-to-code generation (Code Generation task) using multimodal LLMs. The evaluation uses automatic metrics including code similarity components and GPT-4o as a judge for image comparison. No human evaluation was conducted. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of similar metrics.
